__comment: DelightfulCompat override of farmersknives:cincinnasite_knife_diamond. Upstream ships this recipe unconditionally, but the output knife 'farmersknives:cincinnasite_knife_diamond' is only registered when its metal mod is present, so vanilla load logs a hard parse error when it (and its ingredient mod) are absent. The item_exists gate loads the recipe verbatim when the knife exists and drops it cleanly otherwise.
